senses.gloss:
रैभ रैभ, अस्, m. (fr. रेभ), a patronymic;
(ई), f., Ved., scil. ऋच्, epithet of particular ritualistic
verses; N. of the three verses, Atharva-veda XX.
127, 4-6 (so called from the word रेभ occurring
several times).

रैभ्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Rebha, N. of
a son of Sumati and father of Dushyanta.
